rationale: Adds a third external migration path: one Home Assistant picture-elements card becomes a House Plan space with the backdrop reference and devices, value badges and live labels at the card's percentage positions, with image proportions measured locally and a loss report before download. Serves administrators moving the most common community floorplan; tooling-class implementation deployed with the converter site, as #937.

summary.ru: Внешний конвертер переносит карточку picture-elements: подложка ссылкой, устройства и подписи на своих местах, потери перечислены до скачивания.
summary.en: The external converter brings a picture-elements card into House Plan: backdrop reference, devices and labels at their positions, losses listed before download.
